lead_independence.headline: Fort Pierce man arrested on eight burglary charges in Port St. Lucie Spanish Lakes community
lead_independence.lead: Herman Nettles, 44, was taken into custody after an off-duty sheriff's deputy spotted him on U.S. 1. Deputy Martinez-Delgado with the St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office was assigned to the case earlier this week. Information about the case, including a photo of Nettles and a map showing the location of eight reported incidents in the Spanish Lakes One community, was shared with agency personnel.
